profile.headline: Software Engineer at MIT Lincoln Laboratory
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 25+ years of experience in software development, specializing in image processing algorithms, embedded parallel computing, and high-performance applications. Expertise in designing and deploying solutions for airborne/ground 3D LiDAR sensor data processing, 3D breast imaging and computed tomography (CT). Currently focused on optimizing machine learning models for fast inference and large-scale data processing. Demonstrated leadership in team management, project execution, troubleshooting, and training. Strong communicator with a passion for innovative and high-performance solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As Lead Engineer, I specialize in developing cutting-edge data processing solutions for airborne and ground-based 3D LiDAR sensors, with a focus on real-time signal and image processing. I drive innovation to push the boundaries of both hardware and software, ensuring the seamless operation of high-throughput systems.

My role involves designing and optimizing complex algorithms for performance-driven applications, leveraging industry-standard technologies including CUDA, OpenCL, and Vitis. I utilize C, C++, and Python to tackle sophisticated image processing and parallel computing challenges, delivering highly efficient and scalable solutions.

Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, I continuously enhance data analysis workflows to meet the demanding processing requirements of next-generation sensor systems. My work is instrumental in advancing the capabilities of real-time data processing, enabling new insights and capabilities in the field of 3D LiDAR sensing.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led the design and implementation of GPU-accelerated applications for advanced CT image processing, significantly enhancing image quality while reducing processing time, enabling faster diagnostics and improving overall system performance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As Lead Engineer, I spearheaded the design and implementation of GPU-accelerated, high-performance applications in critical areas of medical imaging, including Breast Tomosynthesis, Digital Mammography CAD, and Specimen Radiography Systems. My work played a key role in enhancing imaging quality, performance, and computational efficiency, significantly advancing diagnostic capabilities in healthcare.

I took on a leadership role in training and mentoring the science team on GPGPU (General-Purpose Graphics Processing Unit) and parallel processing techniques, fostering a culture of innovation and knowledge-sharing.

positions.title: Software Manager
positions.description:
Led and managed a high-performing team of developers to successfully deliver multiple information systems tailored for healthcare and business administration, driving operational efficiency and improved decision-making for end-users. 

Oversaw end-to-end project life cycles, from design and development to deployment and maintenance, ensuring the consistent delivery of high-quality software solutions on time and within scope, while adhering to industry best practices.

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
Led the design and implementation of data communication networks, ensuring robust, scalable, and secure infrastructure to support organizational operations. I played a key role in analyzing and developing policies and procedures for critical solutions within the Faults Manager System and SSN7, streamlining processes and enhancing system reliability.

In addition, I trained and mentored over 300 employees, delivering comprehensive training programs that empowered staff with the knowledge and skills necessary to effectively operate and maintain these complex systems, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.
